name: fractal
title_zh: 让 Agent 自己生 Agent
tagline_zh: 别写死子任务清单了。给一个根目标，它自动分裂出子节点、各自递归执行、再汇总收敛。
tagline_en: Stop hardcoding subtask lists. Give one root goal, it spawns child agents, recurses, and converges. Built for.
desc_en: Spawn and manage child nodes -- recursive autonomous agent loops.
why_zh: 不是静态 DAG，是活的进程树。每个节点能自己决定要不要再分叉。
why_en: Not a static DAG but a living process tree. Each node decides whether to fork, retries on failure, and rolls back — delegation.
limit_zh: 只负责 spawn 和 manage，不提供任何任务规划逻辑；子节点要自己带 prompt 和退出条件。没有预算控制。
limit_en: Only spawns and manages nodes; no built-in planning or exit criteria. You must supply prompts and stop conditions. No budget guard — runaway.
title_en: Let an agent spawn agents until the task itself says stop
